items.name: Brisbane's 20 in 20 in 2020
items.information: It's 2020, which only means one thing: time for a NON-STOP 20 HOUR COMPETITION with exactly 20 ROUNDS. Yes, we're a bit crazy, but it's going to be awesome. Note that the main events will occur during the middle of the 20 hours, such that most competitors should only need to be present during the more regular hours of the day. For more informations, please look at the [FAQ page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Brisbanes20in20in2020#13966-faq) and [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Brisbanes20in20in2020#competition-schedule). ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. **Square-1 is the main event at this competition!** This is one of the highest cubing competitions in North America at over 9,000 feet from sea level. The venue is located a long ways outside of Colorado Springs to reach new competitors in Colorado. Due to limited space and seating, we can only accomodate 75 competitors. Due to this, competitors are asked to keep guests to a minimum to ensure that there is room for the competitors. Competitors should register early to ensure a spot. All competitors will have a lanyard with assignments and rounds that you are competing in there when you arrive. Pets are not allowed inside of the venue unless they are service animals.

items.name: Madryn al Cubo 2020
items.information: # Esta competencia ha sido cancelada debido a la epidemia de COVID-19. Madryn al Cubo 2020 será la segunda competencia realizada en la ciudad de Puerto Madryn y la provincia del Chubut. Constara de dos dias de torneo en el transcurso de las vacaciones de invierno. Tendra un total de 16 rondas en 7 categorias distinas en las que se podra competir. ___ # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Madryn al Cubo 2020 will be the second competition ever to be hosted in the province of Chubut and the city of Puerto Madryn. It will last two days during the winter break. It will feature sixteen rounds in seven events.
